entries.title: Signal · AI agent evaluation
entries.content: Scraped signal for AI agent evaluation. Topics: agent evaluation, long-horizon tasks, rubric-based scoring, partial credit, constraint violations, evaluation harness.

entries.title: Research · Rubrics as rewards
entries.content: Rubric-based reward models improve post-training on tasks without verifiable answers. Preference data quality matters more than quantity. Reward model design and reward hacking are central risks.

entries.title: Research · RL environments
entries.content: Reinforcement learning environments with verifiable rewards and tool use are required to train long-horizon AI agents. Stateful environments expose failures that single-turn benchmarks miss.

entries.title: Voice · research-credible, anti-hype
entries.content: Research-credible, anti-hype, confident, declarative, plain English. No motivational cliches and no promotional openers.

entries.title: Rule 7 · Relevance
entries.content: The topic must be meaningfully relevant to reinforcement learning, post-training, agentic systems, evaluation and synthetic data.

entries.title: Crypto trading bots
entries.content: Crypto trading and token price speculation are out of scope for the brand.
